method: Two source-module copies with separate lazy gate workers and temporary common directories; register once and complete one first-admission warmup per side, then 30 sequential pairs, alternating before/after order each pair. Time await admit followed by await finish with performance.now(). No parallel measurements or fsync mocking; host machine shared with other Room work. Quantiles use nearest-rank ceil(n*p).
interpretation: Final warm admit+finish p50 improved 85.9%, p95 80.1%. Host load was not isolated; absolute latency varied between runs. The final run includes the durable first-admission marker design. First-admission timings are individual observations, not quantiles. These measurements do not qualify the end-to-end hook or lifecycle budgets.
design: AtomicOptions defaults to durable true. Gate guards and per-call tickets use durable false; registrations, first-admission hasHeldTickets marker, gate transitions and recovery audits retain fsync. Marked ticketless registrations block drain until clean unregister or verified-dead audited registration:<nonce> recovery. closeStorageGates drains accepted RPCs, refuses racing calls and joins the worker; later calls may restart it.
